tasks.title: Add auto-fix + full re-check to review stage
tasks.description: After the self-check round in runPipelineReviewStage, parse the verdict from review.md. If PASS, return awaiting-user as before. If FAIL: (1) send auto-fix prompt on same conn, (2) close conn, (3) open new conn, (4) re-run buildReviewerPrompt + buildReviewSelfCheckPrompt (full re-check, not targeted), (5) parse new verdict, (6) return awaiting-user regardless — no retry, no escalation. Emit round events for auto-fix, re-review, re-review-self-check. Covers spec requirements: Auto-fix on same ACP connection, Full re-check on new ACP connection, Single auto-fix attempt, No escalation on auto-fix failure, Auto-fix event emission.
acceptanceCriteria: Review stage parses verdict from review.md after self-check
PASS verdict skips auto-fix and returns requiresApproval: true
FAIL verdict triggers auto-fix prompt on same ACP connection
Auto-fix prompt failure falls back to requiresApproval: true with error message
After auto-fix, old connection is closed and new connection opened
Re-check runs full buildReviewerPrompt + buildReviewSelfCheckPrompt (not targeted)
Re-check PASS returns message noting auto-fix succeeded
Re-check FAIL returns message noting auto-fix attempted but still FAIL
No escalation to build stage on any failure path
plan_round_start events emitted with roundType auto-fix, re-review, re-review-self-check
Typecheck passes
